verdict.rationale: First-party docs show sandboxes are isolated Linux microVMs created programmatically through the `@vercel/sandbox` SDK or a single CLI command (`sandbox create`, `sandbox run`), with a ready default image and automatic auth on Vercel. Speed is only implied: the docs say snapshots are faster than creating from scratch but give no boot time. Missing for 10: a documented boot/startup time showing a live environment in seconds, a concrete SDK create code example, and independent or hands-on corroboration of provisioning speed.
